proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + species_trait family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The v4 taxonomy defines species_trait_root but types.ts provides no SpeciesTraitRecord shape. Orc Adrenaline Rush cannot be encoded without this structural addition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As an Orc, you have these special traits. ***Adrenaline Rush.***

proposed_widenings.name: grant_temporary_hp effect (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Temporary Hit Points equal to Proficiency Bonus on activation. HealHpEffect restores actual HP; temporary HP is mechanically distinct (buffer layer, non-stacking). No GrantTemporaryHpEffect exists in ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_temporary_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: v4 taxonomy has no grant_temporary_hp atom. The heal atom covers HP restoration; temporary HP is a separate mechanical concept with different rules (non-stackable buffer, lost first before real HP). Needs a distinct atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus

proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap proficiency_bonus variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Use count equals Proficiency Bonus (2-6 scaling with character level). Current UseCountCap supports fixed uses or threshold_tiers. While LevelAxis includes proficiency_bonus, expressing use count = PB cleanly needs either a dedicated cap variant or documented convention for PB-axis threshold tiers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no species_trait kind in UnitRecord. Secondary blockers are grant_temporary_hp (new atom needed — v4 has no such atom) and PB-scaled use count cap. The bonus-action activation cost and short-or-long-rest reset cadence ARE expressible with existing surface types once the structural kind is added. The Dash-as-Bonus-Action effect maps loosely to grant_extra_action with restriction to dash only, but the semantics differ (it grants a specific standard action via bonus action, not an extra action on top of normal economy).
